name: Project Kraj
description: A monstrous biotechnological experiment by the Simic and Golgari that absorbs cytoplasts across the city.

description_citations.text: "The Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig proposes pitting Razia and the Azorius sky marshals in a bidding war to fund Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: We could create a fine bidding war—enough to fund the final stages of Project Kraj.

citation.text: Assault Zeppelid (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig says Experiment Kraj was designed to choose its own evolution.
timeline.quote: it was designed to choose its own evolution.

citation.text: Experiment Kraj (Dissension, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the Decamillennial, Izolda uses dragon spinal fluid and the blood of Jarad and Myc to rouse Rakdos, who wreaks havoc until absorbed by Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: Rakdos awakened and wreaked havoc in the streets of Ravnica until the demon crossed the path of Project Kraj .

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Simic and Golgari activate Project Kraj, which absorbs cytoplasts across the city.
timeline.quote: Kraj began absorbing cytoplasts from across the city

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The remaining nephilim are stopped by Fonn's Ledev team and Rakdos; Rakdos and Kraj fight to a draw and both are incapacitated; Rakdos returns to his lava pit and Svogthir and Momir Vig are killed.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
